text:
maria: heads up — we saw a pattern during the eu region TLS rekey window where SSE clients stay connected but stop getting chunks for ~30-90s, then resume. console shows no socket-close. seems like our keepalive-squelch rollout suppressed pings during rekey and clients never triggered reconnect.

sam: :eyes: do you have trace ids or a sample request?

maria: trace: 8b7f2c, link to console span: https://console/redwood/trace/8b7f2c. observed headers: `x-resume-id: r-12345`, last-event-id increments but no events delivered. ops-bot alert kicked at 2026-02-12T03:15:09Z with "sse.no-output" counter spike.

jonathan: wonder if proxy did a half-close and our client-side debounce suppressed reconnect due to the new keepalive heuristics. that squelch flag was added to reduce fanout pings during noisy rekeys.

lee: can you paste the client request/response raw? low chance it's client bug.

maria: here's curl repro we used from an internal VM (works intermittently):

```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://eu1-api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-xxx" \
  --max-time 120
```

When the server hits rekey, the TCP session persists (no FIN/RST) but no SSE frames for ~45s. Afterwards frames resume mid-stream (client sees a gap).

sam: I pulled metric: `sse.keepalive_suppressed_total` spikes align with the gap window. also `proxy.tls_rekey_count` correlates. sampling rate for session traces was 1%. we need more traces.

jonathan: question for product: are apps ok with stalled-but-resumed semantics (partial output gap) or do we prefer forced reconnect on rekey? current rollout aimed to avoid double-cost from immediate reconnects.

maria: product said graceful resume is preferred except for blocking UX (e.g., chat UIs show spinner forever). some apps do show spinner and never surface resumed tokens.

lee: ops-bot just posted alert details:
ops-bot: ALERT sse.no-output spike -> 183 events in 5m (eu1). top affected customers: acct-42, acct-77.

sam: proposal: add a transient expo timeout on the client-side: if no SSE frames for >10s during a rekey-window marker, force a resume attempt. server should advertise `x-rekey-hint` header during rekey so clients can decide.

jonathan: we also need better console telemetry: currently `sse.keepalive_suppressed_total` is emitted but not tied to route/model/tenant in the console rollup. please add labels: route, tenant_id, model_family.

maria: +1 to labels. also add a per-session metric `sse.stall_duration_seconds` histogram.

lee: short-term mitigation: roll back keepalive-squelch to 0.75 -> 0.5 threshold in eu region to reduce suppression during known rekey windows. ops can flip.

sam: I'll open a canary flag and add a console banner for the rollback. also increasing tracing sample to 10% for the next 2h.

maria: creating runbook ticket: RB-2219 and adding owners.

jonathan: follow-ups: 1) server side: emit `x-rekey-hint` and resume-friendly header; 2) client: implement short stall-to-reconnect heuristic; 3) console: label metrics and histogram; 4) ops: temporary tweak of squelch threshold + increase tracing. assign owners.

lee: owner list in RB-2219: maria (investigate), sam (telemetry/flags), jonathan (runtime change), lee (ops rollback). target: hotfix today, full fix in next release. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — I'm on it, will update thread with trace slices and a short postmortem after hotfix. :fire:
